image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is a translucent olive-green plastic. A yellow paper label with handwritten red text is affixed to the top. Two circular spool hubs are visible on the left and right, connected by a dark rectangular window in the center showing the magnetic tape. Below the spools, there are molded details including small rectangular slots and screw holes. The image has a grainy, noisy texture typical of older digital photography or film scans.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red handwriting on the label is stylized and largely illegible. While this could be real bad handwriting, AI generators often struggle with coherent text, resulting in 'fake script' that mimics the look of writing without forming valid characters. It is ambiguous but suspicious.

The image has a very uniform, fine-grained noise pattern across both the subject and the background. This looks more like digital sensor noise or added film grain than natural optical blur, potentially masking subtle generation artifacts or indicating a post-processing filter applied to an AI image.

The edges of the central rectangular window where the tape is visible are slightly soft and irregular. In a real molded plastic part, these edges would be sharper. This slight 'melting' or softness is a common minor artifact in AI-generated rigid objects.
